sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
python3 - <<'PY'
import csv, itertools
with open('input.csv','rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
print('bytes',len(data),'newline crlf',data.count(b'\r\n'),'lf',data.count(b'\n'))
lines=data.split(b'\n')
print('num split',len(lines), 'last',repr(lines[-1][:100]))
# inspect separators counts distribution first 100k maybe all
from collections import Counter
cnt=Counter()
non3=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if not l: continue
    c=l.count(b',')
    cnt[c]+=1
    if c!=2 and len(non3)<20: non3.append((i,l))
print('comma count dist',cnt)
print('non3 samples',non3)
# expected
with open('expected.csv','rb') as f: exp=f.read()
print('exp bytes',len(exp),'crlf',exp.count(b'\r\n'),'lf',exp.count(b'\n'))
el=exp.split(b'\n')
print('exp last',repr(el[-1][:100]))
# compare transforms
import re
c=Counter()
bad=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if not l: continue
    parts=l.split(b',')
    exp_l=el[i]
    # try transform
    t=b';'.join(p.strip().upper() for p in parts[::-1])+b';OK'
    if t!=exp_l:
        if len(bad)<20: bad.append((i,l,exp_l,t))
print('bad transform count samples',len(bad))
for x in bad: print(x)
PY
EOF

sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /workspace
mkvim() { cat > "$1" <<VIM
call setreg('a', "$2")
call setreg('b', "$3")
call setreg('c', "$4")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
wq
VIM
}
# V1 fast non-idempotent
mkvim /tmp/v1.vim 'gUU:s/ //g\r' 'f,:s/\([^,]*\),\([^,]*\),\(.*\)/\3;\2;\1\r' 'A;OK\e'
# V2 idempotent: a strips optional ;OK then uppercase/spaces; b guard+reverse; c append
mkvim /tmp/v2.vim 'gUU:s/\(;OK\)\?$//\rf :s/ //g\r' 'f,:s/\([^,]*\),\([^,]*\),\(.*\)/\3;\2;\1\r' 'A;OK\e'
# V3 idempotent: a gUU+f guard+space; b strip optional marker + guard reverse; c append
mkvim /tmp/v3.vim 'gUUf :s/ //g\r' ':s/\(;OK\)\?$//\rf,:s/\([^,]*\),\([^,]*\),\(.*\)/\3;\2;\1\r' 'A;OK\e'
for v in v1 v2 v3; do
  cp input.csv /tmp/$v.csv
  echo === $v ===
  /usr/bin/time -f '%e sec' vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/$v.csv -S /tmp/$v.vim 2>&1
  echo "exit $?"
  cmp /tmp/$v.csv expected.csv && echo MATCH || echo DIFF
  cp /tmp/$v.csv /tmp/${v}_1.csv
  /usr/bin/time -f 'rerun %e sec' vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/$v.csv -S /tmp/$v.vim 2>&1
  echo "rerun exit $?"
  cmp /tmp/$v.csv expected.csv && echo MATCH2 || echo DIFF2
done
EOF
